cohort: 154 infants born at ≤30 weeks gestation who had MRI imaging at term-equivalent age and neurodevelopmental testing at 18⁻24 months
finding: A prediction model incorporating MRI scores and clinical factors (ventilator days, delivery mode, antenatal steroids, retinopathy of prematurity requiring surgery) effectively differentiated severe neurodevelopmental outcomes from normal-moderate outcomes at two years.
mod_finding: Delivery mode was a significant predictor of neurodevelopmental outcomes in the final model.
